name: mica
description: Mica — a Git-native content editor for Astro websites.

scripts.//dev: The CMS alone. It edits the example project's content, so run the example's own `pnpm dev` beside it to see the website.
scripts.//cms:backup: There is no backup script: the content is in Git, and the database holds only accounts and sessions.
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules examples/*/node_modules sites/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules packages/*/dist apps/*/dist examples/*/dist sites/*/dist
